# The Sullivans Division, U.S. Naval Sea Cadet Corps

> Official website of The Sullivans Division, a congressionally chartered
> non-profit youth program in Buffalo, New York for ages 10 through high
> school. Participation carries no military service obligation. Named for the
> five Sullivan brothers lost aboard USS Juneau in 1942.

Enrollment runs through the national Sea Cadets organization, not this site.
Prospects select "The Sullivans Division, Buffalo NY" at the national site.
This website collects no personal information about cadets or minors.

## Pages

- [Join the division](/join): eligibility, cost expectations, and the national enrollment handoff
- [About](/about): what cadets actually do, NLCC and NSCC program split
- [Division store](/store): unit essentials and division merchandise
- [Contact](/contact): questions answered by a person, usually within two days
- [Resources](/resource-hub): forms and reference material for cadets and families

## Off-site

- [National enrollment](https://www.seacadets.org/join): the only place to enroll
- [U.S. Naval Sea Cadet Corps](https://www.seacadets.org/): the national organization
